Milan's 4-2 defeat by Bologna on Wednesday, to go with Inter's late-show 2-0 win at Venezia, increased the gap to seven points between the city and stadium rivals. Fifth in Serie A, Amorim's men have started to come unstuck in recent weeks, a 3-0 Europa League loss at Bournemouth preceding the Bologna reverse. The Portuguese boss is hopeful influential trio Mario Gila, Adrien Rabiot and Diego Moreira will return from injury, while 20-year-old rising star Alphadjo Cisse looks to add to his seven goals this season.
Inter needed to own goals to overcome a spirited Venezia in midweek, but victory took the Nerazzurri top of the pile on goal difference from Lazio, who are also unbeaten. Absent since the surprise Champions League defeat by Club Brugge four games ago, talismanic captain Lautaro Martinez will again be absent, leaving much of the heavy attacking lifting to five-goal Marcus Thuram. Winless in the past seven Milan derbies, Inter need creative spark Nicolo Barella to step up.
